t: Inside the YASA YM360: Axial Flux Motor Engineering Explained

q.x: That was a good video, and I also liked the Munro video that does a nice job of explaining how these work: [link]

desc:
In this teardown, we take a closer look at the YASA YM360 axial flux motor and the engineering decisions driving its impressive performance.

We analyze the motor’s compact architecture, rotor and stator design, cooling strategy, material selection, and power density advantages while comparing it to conventional radial flux motors.

Munro Live is the media division of Munro & Associates, an engine
